summary: Bicara Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a press release on Phase 1/1b clinical trial results for ficerafusp alfa combined with pembrolizumab in first-line recurrent/metastatic HPV-negative head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The filing discloses interim three-year overall survival data and safety profile to be presented at ASCO 2026. No corporate transaction, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special situation is announced. The 8-K is a routine current report on clinical data disclosure, not a special-situation event.
